title: Dolibarr
name: dolibarr
description: ERP and CRM for small businesses and freelancers: contacts, quotes, orders, invoices and payments, stock, projects, expense reports, HR and accounting. You switch on just the parts you need. Source: https://github.com/Dolibarr/dolibarr

env.name: DOLIBARR_ADMIN_PASSWORD
env.label: Admin password (required)
env.description: For the admin login. No spaces. Only used on the very first start, change it in Dolibarr after that.

env.name: DOLIBARR_SECRET_KEY
env.label: Secret key (required)
env.description: Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32. Keep it the same when you redeploy, or saved bank details, API keys and mail passwords can't be read.

env.name: DOLIBARR_DB_PASSWORD
env.label: Database password (required)
env.description: Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 16. Keep it the same when you redeploy.

env.name: DOLIBARR_PORT
env.label: Host port for the web UI

env.name: DOLIBARR_URL
env.label: Address you'll open it on
env.description: Like http://192.168.1.20:8480. Shared document links and links in emails point here.

note: Fill in the admin password, secret key and database password before you deploy (openssl rand -hex 32 makes good secrets), since the stack won't start without them, and keep the key and database password the same when you redeploy. The first start takes a few minutes while it fills the database, so the page won't load straight away. Then open http://<your-host>:8480 (or whichever port you picked) and log in as admin with your password. It sends you to Setup first: add your company's name, country and currency (it starts in euros), then switch on the modules you want under Setup --> Modules. There are no sign-ups, you add everyone else under Users & Groups. Put the address you'll actually type in the browser in the address field too, since shared document links and links in emails use it, and they point at localhost until you do. To change it later, edit the address in the stack's environment variables and redeploy. To update, redeploy with the image re-pulled: it backs up the database into the documents volume and upgrades it on start. The first time the home page loads after an install or update, your browser sends Dolibarr an anonymous ping (a hashed id, versions, database type and country). Uploads, generated PDFs and backups live in the dolibarr-documents volume, add-on modules in dolibarr-custom, everything else in db-data. Docs: wiki.dolibarr.org
